description:
Thorough test coverage for the new GenTailscale implementation.

Unit tests:
  - Socket option management (setopts/getopts round-trip)
  - Recv buffer logic (partial reads, exact length, length=0)
  - Controlling process transfer
  - Active mode state machine (false → once → data → false)
  - Active N countdown
  - Message tag configuration
  - Close/shutdown behavior

Integration tests (require running tailscale or headscale):
  - Listen → accept → send → recv round-trip
  - Multiple concurrent connections
  - Large data transfer (verify integrity)
  - Close during pending recv
  - SSL handshake + data transfer
  - Controlling process transfer with in-flight data

Property tests (StreamData):
  - Arbitrary binary data survives send/recv intact
  - recv(socket, n) always returns exactly n bytes (or error)
  - Active mode messages delivered in order without loss/duplication
  - Concurrent send/recv from multiple processes

Reference: OTP's gen_tcp_SUITE.erl for applicable test cases.
Consider headscale for CI-friendly integration testing.
title: Test suite: unit, integration, and property tests
